mostWorthwhile.text: Activating the fibre with calcium was most worthwhile: the planned sequence connects ATP-powered myosin cycling to sliding filaments without implying that the filaments shorten.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the two muscles felt somewhat repetitive, though the different head and tendon arrangements added useful anatomy.

surprise.text: Relaxation also requires ATP-powered calcium pumping, and the fibre lengthens under an outside pull.

arbitrary.text: Adding collagen-rich matrix to one relaxed fibre to make many fascicles felt like a jump in scale, although the picture explains the connective layers and supplies enough bundles for both muscles.

continue.text: Yes. I'd continue to see how the assembled arm works in a larger system; the connection between muscle attachments and opposite movements was compelling.
